prose: AI physics startup PSI (Physical Superintelligence) says a research system running a non-public Anthropic model proved the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture, open since 2008, which concerns when quantum computers can be exponentially faster than ordinary ones. The page quotes an outside expert calling it a huge result that draws on analysis of boolean functions and probabilistic combinatorics. PSI frames it against Shor's 1994 factoring algorithm as context. This is the company's own announcement; independent verification of the proof is not shown in the text read.
highlights: PSI claims a proof of the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture (open since 2008)
Proof found by PSI's system running a non-public Anthropic model
Conjecture concerns the limits of exponential quantum speedups
Company claim; independent verification not shown
